#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
cd /workspace
git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace
PATCH="$(dirname "$0")/patch.diff"
git apply --verbose --reject "$PATCH"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
python3 - <<'PYCONTROL'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/skbio/sequence/_sequence.py')
s=p.read_text()
assert s.count('            lowercase_mask = self._bytes > self._ascii_lowercase_boundary') == 1
s=s.replace('            lowercase_mask = self._bytes > self._ascii_lowercase_boundary','            lowercase_mask = np.logical_and(self._bytes >= 97, self._bytes <= 122)',1)
assert s.count('        outbytes[index] ^= self._ascii_invert_case_bit_offset') == 1
s=s.replace('        outbytes[index] ^= self._ascii_invert_case_bit_offset','        selected = outbytes[index]\n        outbytes[index] = np.where((selected >= 65) & (selected <= 90), selected | 32, selected)',1)
ast.parse(s)
p.write_text(s)
PYCONTROL
